study type: Guideline (based on a review of existing literature including meta-analyses, systematic reviews, randomized controlled studies, nonrandomized controlled studies, reviews, and case series)
exposure: blunt expansion of the transverse uterine hysterotomy
outcome: best practice recommendations for intraoperative care
cohort: This guideline reviews evidence pertaining to women undergoing scheduled and unscheduled cesarean delivery.
finding: The Enhanced Recovery After Surgery Society guideline provides evidence-based recommendations for intraoperative care during cesarean delivery, aiming to enhance maternal recovery and optimize care.
mod_finding: The guideline provides specific recommendations for intraoperative care during cesarean delivery, including the use of prophylactic antibiotics, patient warming, hysterotomy expansion, skin closure, and delayed cord clamping.
